title: Tanya daily schedule
description: One entry per day of the Hebrew year for both the leap and non-leap partitions. Sivan 1..5 in a leap year mirror the non-leap schedule; only entries covered by the printed Kehot schedule are included.

month.description: Hebrew month (1=Nisan). Adar in a non-leap year and Adar II in a leap year are both 13; Adar I in a leap year is 12.

section.description: Stable SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE key defined in names/tanya_sections.json. The names file holds the en/he/… translations for each key.

chapter.description: Chapter within the section. 0 for front matter (Title Page, Approbation, Compiler's Foreword) that has no chapter numbering.

start.description: First three words of the day's reading (Hebrew).

end.description: Last three words of the day's reading (Hebrew).
